title: Python: Tunnel authorization root + egress
description: Root side: send tunnel-auth POST when route via egress installed. Egress side: tunnel-auth resource, validate signature, cache authorization, check on decapsulation. Per spec 8.11.
notes: Implemented isolated Python root/egress tunnel authorization in python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py with deterministic canonical COSE_Sign1 alg -65537, exact payload schema, prefix/egress/route/key binding, root OSCORE identity enforcement, strict signature verification, bounded LRU authorization cache plus retained bounded replay floors, revocation/rearm, root change and clock rollback fail-closed behavior, source/destination/direction least-privilege policy, and transport-neutral root POST / egress forwarding adapters. Added python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py with fixed independent vector/oracle, malformed/noncanonical/tamper/expiry/replay/capacity/rollback/policy/integration/concurrency and Hypothesis prefix/fuzz coverage. Validation: uv run pytest -q tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py tests/gateway => 240 passed (2 unrelated existing warnings); uv run ruff check + ruff format --check on both files => pass; uv run mypy src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py => pass. Normative alg is -65537 and canonical protected bytes are a1013a00010000; stale spec example a10139ffff decodes -65536, tracked separately as project-LICHEN-worker6-ga42. No shared-file collisions; only two new files modified.
close_reason: Python root and egress tunnel authorization implemented with bounded fail-closed policy and comprehensive focused validation
